findings.description: Direct crouch and seated renders still show substantial undershorts below the lifted overskirt. Pose-matched overskirt ray coverage improved to crouch upper thigh L/R 0.4870/0.4825 and sit 0.4678/0.4678, but remains insufficient; this geometric coverage evidence is not fit acceptance.

The new cut-bound soft box-pleat profile and longer 100 mm hem extension are present in the sewn mesh, but direct front/back/profile renders still show coarse triangular facets and uneven panel highlights rather than controlled fabric pleats. Reduced stiffness and longer settling did not produce the needed surface form.

Crouch and sit views show the skirt lifting around exposed shorts despite the longer hem and pelvis-dominant capped front weights; prone remains an uneven spread. The geometric revision does not establish motion-safe coverage or fabric response.

Direct inspection of all five current views and six pose renders shows a largely plain ivory jacket and broad diagonal lavender panel. Removing the filled elbow patch leaves only faint seam paths; the rear and side still lack enough finished fencing-practice detail.
Back and profile views remain visually plain, with a broad featureless torso/back and abrupt skirt transition; the new surface still lacks a convincing finished rear waist/panel treatment.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V14 directly inspects a sewn mesh with cut-bound eased box-pleat valleys, 100 mm hem extension from v11, lower cloth bending stiffness, 48-frame neutral settling, pelvis-dominant capped front weights, and reduced unfilled elbow seam paths. Pose coverage improved numerically, but direct renders still show coarse uneven pleats and substantial crouch/sit shorts exposure; UV remains uncreated.

nextAction: REJECT. Do not repeat the cut-bound radial pleat field or pelvis-dominant hem weights; v14 still shows coarse uneven folds and exposed shorts in crouch/sit despite a measurable coverage increase. Next change panel-level construction/deformation so the skirt is not driven by a radial silhouette-only wave, and solve front/rear skirt coverage through poses; improve rear jacket detail while retaining restrained elbow geometry. Rebuild and directly review new renders before any acceptance.
